task_fulfillment.rationale: Both deliverables substantially address the request, but the transition-cost analysis omits the already-paid Juvoxa investment when combining replacement costs with the refund. Autonexis's corresponding increase is INR 812.96 Mn, not INR 800.96 Mn. Correct vendor stand-alone totals do not cure this transition-accounting error. Additional email demands also exceed R63.
